aggregation_contract.adjacency_rule: parent faces share at least one collision-triangle edge
aggregation_contract.partition_rule: canonical ascending-parent-face seed; breadth-first expansion over unassigned topology neighbours; fixed maximum parent-face budget
aggregation_contract.selected_scale_interpretation: coarse topology-connected numerical screening scale for sparse particle impacts; not a physical erosion-resolution claim
aggregation_contract.normalization: sum target mass within each connected aggregate, then redistribute to member faces in proportion to face area; exact total-mass conservation

discovery_identity_compatibility.interpretation: Discovery predates the registered AABB performance optimization and the confirmation descriptor adds execution-target provenance; CFD field inputs, topology, partition, physical inputs, parameters and solver semantics match.

confirmation_contract.run_overlap_rule: particle_hits SHA-256 must not appear in the hash-valid discovery report
confirmation_contract.acceptance_interpretation: numerically stable coarse risk map only; never a physical erosion-accuracy or official competition-evidence claim

limitations: The discovery data identify a method candidate but cannot confirm it.
Aggregate stability does not validate the parent-face field.
No worn scan, baseline map, or independent spatial erosion truth is present.
No v5 result may open official accuracy, reference, or FEM gates.
